environment.description: EC2 instance (i-0b7c9d3e2f1a4b5c6) running identical application code in VPC vpc-0def789abc012 in us-east-1. Network Load Balancer (NLB) with TLS termination forwards to instance on port 8080. NLB has no security group (NLBs don't support SGs). Instance security group sg-0cafe9012 allows inbound on port 8080 from source 10.0.0.0/8 only. VPC has no internet gateway; connectivity is via AWS PrivateLink and Transit Gateway peering to corporate network (CIDR 10.128.0.0/16, 10.129.0.0/16). DNS is internal-only via Route 53 private hosted zone (legacy-app.internal.corp). Transit Gateway route table tgw-rtb-0aaa111bbb only propagates routes from attachments tagged Environment=Production-Internal. Corporate egress firewall (Palo Alto PA-5260) at on-prem boundary restricts outbound to sanctioned SaaS endpoints only. No public IP assigned to instance (no EIP, no NAT gateway in VPC). VPC flow logs confirm only source IPs from 10.128.x.x and 10.129.x.x ranges have ever reached the instance in 18 months of operation.

config.nlb_config: internal NLB, scheme=internal, no public DNS
config.vpc_connectivity: no IGW, no NAT GW, Transit Gateway only to corporate CIDR
config.dns: Route 53 private hosted zone, not resolvable externally
config.transit_gateway_routes: tgw-rtb-0aaa111bbb propagates only from Production-Internal tagged attachments
config.public_ip: none (no EIP, no NAT, no IGW)
